name: nizviewer
description: Reveal Indeed job posting dates, salary, work setup, experience, shifts, and tech stacks directly on job cards.

scripts.build:chrome: node scripts/build.js chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --overwrite-dest --filename "nizviewer-{version}-chrome.zip"
scripts.build:firefox: node scripts/build.js firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --overwrite-dest --filename "nizviewer-{version}-firefox.zip"
